title: COTA Reroute Notices
description: Persisted notices extracted from COTA's reroutes page. IDs remain stable when notice content changes.

schema_version.description: Version of the persisted data format.

id.description: Assigned persistent UUID, independent of title, category, and content hash.

category.description: Publisher section, not an inferred operational status.

title.description: Notice heading as plain text, including the publisher's date wording.

html.description: Notice HTML fragment, including its heading and associated paragraphs and lists. HTML syntax and safety require separate checks.

source_url.description: Public page URL, rather than the Gatsby transport endpoint.

content_hash.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the stored html string.

first_seen_at.description: Time the scraper first observed this notice, not its publication date.

updated_at.description: Time the stored title, category, HTML, or source URL last changed. Initially equal to first_seen_at; unchanged scrapes do not update it.

removed_at.description: Time the scraper first observed this notice missing from the source page during a successful, validated scrape, not the exact removal time or a reopening date. Omitted while visible; cleared if the notice reappears.
